review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample 1.1-4.4 (all 13 targets) read against Bonato, Brouwer-Haemers, Godsil, Spielman and Zhao at their locators (22 locators, all supported). Supplier sections resolved on main (CharacterSumsOverFiniteFields 0.1, 3.3, 4.7) and at open heads (StronglyRegularAndMooreGraphs 1.2-1.4, SpectralGraphBounds 1.1, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1). 41 Mathlib names checked at the pin. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 12 theorems. Two format notes (a page range; naming the owner of the general bounded extension property).
